description: Defines the SDT class for handling Service Description Table (SDT) in DVB broadcasting, including nested ServiceIterator class for iterating over services.

classes.name: SDT
classes.description: Represents a DVB Service Description Table with methods to access transport stream info and services.

classes.name: SDT::ServiceIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for traversing services within an SDT.

methods.name: SDT::IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the SDT object contains valid data.

methods.name: SDT::TransportStreamId
methods.description: Returns the transport stream ID associated with the SDT.

methods.name: SDT::OriginalNetworkId
methods.description: Returns the original network ID from the SDT data.

methods.name: SDT::Services
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the services listed in the SDT.

methods.name: SDT::ServiceIterator::Next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next service.

methods.name: SDT::ServiceIterator::ServiceId
methods.description: Returns the service ID of the current service.

methods.name: SDT::ServiceIterator::Descriptors
methods.description: Returns an iterator over descriptors for the current service.
